Kofi and I collaborated briefly during a cross-team integration project last year. As AdTechCo’s Tech Lead, he oversaw a critical initiative to streamline ad-serving workflows, aligning engineering priorities with product goals. His structured approach to problem-solving and ability to translate technical complexity into actionable plans made him a reliable partner.  

Daily, Kofi balanced hands-on architecture decisions with mentoring junior engineers. He reduced deployment times by 30% through optimized CI/CD practices, while ensuring compliance with agile sprints. His cross-team collaboration during a billing system overhaul minimized downtime, earning trust across departments.  

A standout moment came when he rearchitected a legacy API, improving response times by 40% and reducing error rates. During a server outage, he led a 12-hour troubleshooting session, coordinating developers and operations to restore service without data loss. His calm under pressure and technical depth were pivotal.  

Kofi’s blend of strategic thinking and operational rigor makes him a strong fit for any high-stakes tech role. He consistently delivers measurable results while fostering a collaborative environment. I’d recommend him without hesitation for his reliability, technical acumen, and ability to drive innovation within constraints.
